note: The CPU table: eight rule-based players, every one seated every game in a random order. No keys and no model calls; run with --dry (the dashboard's Run 8 CPU players and npm run cpu do), the games stay in this machine's store and show on the dashboard's own copy of the site. Each turn waits turnDelayMs so a game can be watched (pass --delay 0 to play at full speed), and a game stops after maxRounds, the richest winning, since eight rule-based players seldom bankrupt one another and would otherwise play to the engine's limit of a thousand rounds.
